text: A village wedding falls into chaos when the bride turns hysterical and the reog dancers run wild, and a dukun says the sorcery comes from the west. The groom Kohar suspects Murni, his former lover, and the villagers [burn her house and throw her into a ravine|wrong|innocents wrongly punished]. Rescued by Gendon, a sorcerer nursing his own grudge against the village head, Murni, once violated by Kohar, is coaxed into [taking her revenge|wants|revenge for a wrong] through [black magic|threat|witchcraft and cursed things].
